BW Gestao de Investimentos Ltda. Has $5.81 Million Stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Posted by Caroline Horne | Mar 27th, 2018 
BW Gestao de Investimentos Ltda. grew its holdings in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 26.9% during the third quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The firm owned 37,719 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after purchasing an additional 8,000 shares during the period. Apple comprises about 1.2% of BW Gestao de Investimentos Ltda.’s portfolio, making the stock its 10th biggest position. BW Gestao de Investimentos Ltda.’s holdings in Apple were worth $5,813,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
A number of other large investors have also modified their holdings of the business. Weatherly Asset Management L. P. boosted its holdings in Apple by 1.2% in the second quarter. Weatherly Asset Management L. P. now owns 145,460 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $20,949,000 after purchasing an additional 1,773 shares in the last quarter. Grove Bank & Trust boosted its holdings in Apple by 55.6% in the second quarter. Grove Bank & Trust now owns 16,803 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,420,000 after purchasing an additional 6,006 shares in the last quarter. Peoples Bank OH boosted its holdings in Apple by 0.9% in the second quarter. Peoples Bank OH now owns 11,951 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,721,000 after purchasing an additional 109 shares in the last quarter. Welch Investments LLC boosted its holdings in Apple by 1.5% in the second quarter. Welch Investments LLC now owns 1,607 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $231,000 after purchasing an additional 23 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Spectrum Asset Management Inc. NB CA boosted its holdings in Apple by 4.3% in the second quarter. Spectrum Asset Management Inc. NB CA now owns 2,501 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $360,000 after purchasing an additional 103 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors own 61.35% of the company’s stock. AAPL stock traded down $4.43 during trading on Tuesday, reaching $168.34. The company’s stock had a trading volume of 40,922,579 shares, compared to its average volume of 37,625,156. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. The firm has a market capitalization of $836,907.75, a price-to-earnings ratio of 17.30, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.25 and a beta of 1.19. Apple has a 12 month low of $140.06 and a 12 month high of $183.50. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. Apple’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company earned $3.36 earnings per share. equities research analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.38 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
A number of equities analysts recently issued reports on the company. Nomura reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $175.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, March 19th. UBS set a $190.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday. BidaskClub downgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a report on Friday, January 26th. BMO Capital Markets cut Apple from an “outperform” rating to a “market perform” rating and boosted their price objective for the company from $162.00 to $166.00 in a research note on Wednesday, January 31st. Finally, William Blair reiterated an “outperform” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, February 2nd. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-three have issued a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.70. 
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
